full_judgment: 2. The short facts necessary for disposal of the rule are that the plaintiff opposite party Nos. 1-5 filed the suit in the Court of the 3rd Subordinate Judge, Chittagong praying for decree for declaration of title simplicitor and for declaration that the BS Khatian is wrong. Earlier they also filed another suit being other Suit No. 108 of 1999 in the Court of 5th Assistant Judge, Chittagong for the self same land and that was withdrawn on 17-10-2000 with permission to sue afresh subject to payment of costs. Thereafter, the plaintiff filed the present suit on 30-10-2000.
